reviews.t: If you use a straight razor you need this strop
reviews.x: I've Been using a straight razor for some time, I gave up on buying cartridges at 20 dollars a pop. With a straight razor you need to take some care to it, and the most important care is a good strop....plain and simple. Yes this strop cost more then other strops you see here at amazon, and to be honest I own a few of those other strops. But to strop a razor right you need a 3 inch strop because that is the width of a straight razor. Save yourself the headache and buy the right strop and I promi

I bought these specifically for the width, that way when I strop my blade, I could simply go in straight strokes back and forth. Unfortunately, there is a slight curvature from one side edge to the other making an even blade stropping with straight passes impossible. I find that I am back to doing crisscross patterns, which I could have continued to do with my narrow strop. At least they are very attractive looking and so, do not look out of sorts on the counter or hanging from the wall.

Very disappointed.  This is similar in price to straightrazordesigns.com strops, but much worse in quality. I used this strop only twice. It is very stiff, has a twist in it, and doesn't give properly to the blade. I had to send in my razor to get rehoned/sharpened because this strop took the edge off of the lower third of the blade.

reviews.t: Drags on the blade really well
reviews.x: You get what you pay for,  this one does exactly what it says it does. If you just got a straight razor for the 1st time, get a cheaper strop for practice,  YOU WILL NICK THIS.

reviews.t: Now _This_ is a nice strop for a great price!
reviews.x: I've owned a Fromm Illinois strop for awhile, and been pretty happy dor it's mid-$30 value. But when it was time  to upgrade (due to some 'enhancements' my son gifted me with when playing with the Fromm), I decided to give this strop a try: I'll tell you what, it's a damn fine value! It cost roughly 2x what a base Fromm does, but it's also twice the quality in terms of  leather, and hardware. No it's not a $150 strop's quality. But it's also only half the price. I'm one happy customer! :D

reviews.x: I recently bought this and thought it was good quality.  I hacked it up pretty good and bought one from straight razor designs.  Let me tell you there is no comparing.  This feels like a dried out wrinkly piece of crap compared to that supple latigo from SRD. claims.text: Reviewers widely praise the strop's high-quality leather and durable, long-lasting construction.
Many consider it well worth the price and a good value.
Some reviewers report quality-control problems such as stiffness, a twist, or curvature that prevents an even stropping draw.
Several note it is a great choice for beginners, though some advise practicing on a cheaper strop first since it can be nicked.
A few reviewers describe the leather quality as good but not exceptional.
